_capture.detail: Reconstructed from the attached Tesla Find Us screenshot of Antlers, OK (findus 492964, Francis Energy at Gardner Grocery, 319 W Main St). Akamai returned 403 for a live fetch from this environment, so this is not a byte-for-byte __NEXT_DATA__ payload. The expanded section was Pricing for Tesla & Members, with a busy-times chart. The five per-kWh prices, in chart order, were $0.44, $0.48, $0.52, $0.48, $0.44. The labels under the chart were 4a, 8a, 2p, 7p, 11p. Those labels are stored as chart axis text, not as clock-range boundaries, because the page did not print start and end times. The line under the chart read Congestion fees (up to $0.50/min). Pricing for Non-Tesla was collapsed, so no non-Tesla rates are stored. pricingChart is capture metadata beside the books. A live __NEXT_DATA__ pull is not expected to include that key.
